module: M2: NASA Earth Observation Data Processing & Geospatial Analytics
dataset_name: Bengaluru Urban Pilot Geospatial Indicator Dataset
general_scientific_disclaimer: This dataset provides satellite Earth observation (EO) and reanalysis indicators resampled or nearest-neighbor assigned to a uniform 1 km x 1 km grid over Bengaluru Urban. Satellite products have native spatial footprints ranging from 250 m to ~55 km. Gridded values do NOT represent true sub-grid in-situ ground truth at 1 km; spatial uncertainty, aggregation effects, and land-cover heterogeneity must be considered in downstream modeling (M3).

grid_id.name: Grid Cell Identifier
grid_id.description: Unique, deterministic identifier assigned to each 1 km cell based on State Census Code (29 = Karnataka), District Code (525 = Bengaluru Urban), and national projected planar coordinate grid origin in EPSG:7755 (Survey of India).

data_date.name: Observation Date
data_date.description: Calendar observation date represented by the dataset (2016-01-01).

resolution_m.name: Spatial Resolution
resolution_m.description: Nominal horizontal cell width and height (1000 metres).

centroid_lat.name: Centroid Latitude
centroid_lat.description: Geographic latitude of the grid cell polygon geometric centroid in WGS84.

centroid_lon.name: Centroid Longitude
centroid_lon.description: Geographic longitude of the grid cell polygon geometric centroid in WGS84.

geometry.name: Cell Polygon Geometry
geometry.description: Closed boundary ring polygon defining the exact 1 km x 1 km cell footprint in WGS84.

data_quality.name: Overall Cell Data Quality Classification
data_quality.description: Summary data quality flag. 'estimated' reflects that rainfall and climate variables are derived from satellite/reanalysis models rather than in-situ weather stations.

rainfall_mm.description: Total liquid-equivalent precipitation accumulated over the 24-hour observation day (2016-01-01 00:00:00 to 23:59:59 UTC).
rainfall_mm.nasa_source_product: NASA GPM IMERG Final Run V07B (Half-Hourly/Daily Combined Precipitation)
rainfall_mm.assignment_method: Zonal area-weighted / nearest-grid-cell mapping to 1 km cells
rainfall_mm.quality_control_method: Multi-satellite radiometer/radar precipitation estimates calibrated with GPCC monthly rain-gauge analysis.
rainfall_mm.meaning_of_null: Precipitation data unavailable, corrupted, or uncalibrated.
known_limitations: Native resolution is ~0.1 degree (~11 km); multiple 1 km cells share the same coarse source satellite retrieval.
On 2016-01-01 (mid-winter dry season in South India), GPM IMERG recorded 0.00 mm across Bengaluru Urban; valid zero rainfall must remain strictly 0.0 and not be confused with null.
IMERG Final Run calibrates with monthly gauge averages but does not capture localized micro-scale convective showers at 1 km resolution.

temperature_min_c.description: Minimum surface air temperature measured 2 metres above the surface during the calendar day.
temperature_min_c.assignment_method: Nearest valid NASA POWER regional grid point assignment
temperature_min_c.quality_control_method: Global atmospheric data assimilation system (GEOS-5 FP-IT / MERRA-2) incorporating global radiosonde, satellite radiance, and surface observations.
temperature_min_c.meaning_of_null: Reanalysis grid node missing or outside model domain.
known_limitations: Derived from global atmospheric reanalysis on a coarse ~55 km grid node.
Values represent smooth regional synoptic background temperatures and do not resolve local urban heat island (UHI) micro-variability at 1 km.
Values are model assimilation estimates, not direct in-situ measurements.

temperature_max_c.description: Maximum surface air temperature measured 2 metres above the surface during the calendar day.
temperature_max_c.assignment_method: Nearest valid NASA POWER regional grid point assignment
temperature_max_c.quality_control_method: Global atmospheric data assimilation system (GEOS-5 FP-IT / MERRA-2).
temperature_max_c.meaning_of_null: Reanalysis grid node missing or outside model domain.
known_limitations: Coarse regional reanalysis footprint (~55 km).
Does not capture localized thermal gradients across varying urban canopy and impervious surface fractions at 1 km.
Regional background temperature estimate, not independent station data.

humidity_pct.description: Mean relative humidity at 2 metres above ground level, computed from 2-metre air temperature and dew point.
humidity_pct.assignment_method: Nearest valid NASA POWER regional grid point assignment
humidity_pct.quality_control_method: Assimilated atmospheric moisture fields in MERRA-2 bounded between 0% and 100%.
known_limitations: Regional reanalysis model estimate on ~55 km grid node.
Atmospheric boundary-layer moisture represents regional air mass rather than localized evapotranspiration pockets at 1 km.

soil_moisture_pct.human_readable_name: Volumetric Topsoil Moisture Percentage (0–5 cm depth)
soil_moisture_pct.description: Volumetric soil moisture content in the top 5 cm of soil, expressed as volumetric water fraction percentage (% m³/m³).
soil_moisture_pct.nasa_source_product: NASA SMAP SPL3SMP Version 009 (L3 Radiometer Daily 36 km EASE-Grid 2.0)
soil_moisture_pct.assignment_method: Nearest valid regional SMAP 36 km pixel assignment
soil_moisture_pct.quality_control_method: Strict 3-bit flag filter: (retrieval_qual_flag_pm & 0b111) == 0; valid range 0.02 to 0.50 m³/m³.
soil_moisture_pct.meaning_of_null: No valid SMAP pixel within regional domain, or retrieval disqualified by radio-frequency interference (RFI) / frozen ground.
known_limitations: Native radiometer footprint is ~36 km; exactly five valid SMAP pixels enclose the 2,380 Bengaluru Urban grid cells.
Central urban core pixels failed the strict radiometer quality mask due to heavy radio-frequency interference and high impervious surface fraction (retrieval_qual_flag = 9).

Cells are mapped to the nearest of 5 valid surrounding peri-urban/rural pixels (max distance 37.91 km). Values reflect regional soil moisture background and do not capture 1 km sub-grid impervious surface variations.

ndvi.description: Continuously scaled vegetation greenness and canopy vigour index calculated from MODIS surface reflectance bands: (NIR - Red) / (NIR + Red).
ndvi.nasa_source_product: NASA MODIS/Terra MOD13Q1 Version 061 (16-Day L3 Global 250m Sinusoidal Grid, Tile h25v07)
ndvi.native_spatial_resolution: 250 m Sinusoidal Grid (~231.66 m x 231.66 m)
ndvi.assignment_method: Centroid 250 m pixel sampling, with within-cell 250 m pixel mean fallback; null otherwise
ndvi.quality_control_method: Strict QA filter: pixel_reliability == 0 (Good Data) AND (VI_Quality & 0b11) == 0 (VI produced, good quality). Raw fill value -3000 excluded.
ndvi.meaning_of_null: Pixel failed strict quality screening due to high aerosol scattering, sub-pixel cloud contamination, shadow, or dense urban surface interference.
known_limitations: Strict quality filtering (pixel_reliability == 0) excludes marginal pixels affected by high urban aerosols in central Bengaluru. This produces 1,087 null cells in the urban core.
Null values MUST NOT be interpreted as zero vegetation; they indicate satellite atmospheric or surface retrieval uncertainty.
Composite spans 16 calendar days from 2016-01-01 to 2016-01-16 to select the highest-quality cloud-free observations.

evapotranspiration_mm.description: Total terrestrial evapotranspiration (canopy transpiration, soil evaporation, and canopy interception evaporation) accumulated over the 8-day composite window.
evapotranspiration_mm.nasa_source_product: NASA MODIS/Terra MOD16A2GF Version 061 (8-Day L4 Global 500m Sinusoidal Grid, Tile h25v07, Year-End Gap-Filled)
evapotranspiration_mm.native_spatial_resolution: 500 m Sinusoidal Grid (~463.31 m x 463.31 m)
evapotranspiration_mm.assignment_method: Centroid 500 m pixel sampling, with within-cell 500 m pixel mean fallback; null otherwise
evapotranspiration_mm.quality_control_method: Valid physical raw range (-32767 to 32700); discrete special codes 32761–32767 strictly excluded. ET_QC_500m Bit 0 recorded for diagnostics per NASA MOD16 GF user guide.
evapotranspiration_mm.meaning_of_null: Surface is not modeled by the Penman-Monteith logic (e.g., Code 32762 = Urban/Built-up impervious surface, Code 32766 = Water body), or nodata fill (Code 32767).
known_limitations: Value represents total evapotranspiration accumulated over 8 calendar days (mm/8day), NOT a single-day rate. For mean daily equivalent (mm/day), divide by 8.
MOD16 Penman-Monteith algorithm does not calculate evapotranspiration over impervious urban/built-up land cover (Code 32762); 209 cells in central Bengaluru remain strictly null.
Null values MUST NOT be replaced with 0.0; 0.0 implies zero evaporation on a vegetated surface, whereas null indicates an unmodeled impervious surface.
MOD16A2GF year-end gap-filling applies exclusively to LAI/FPAR inputs (MOD15A2H) and does not fill urban or water surfaces.
